source_text: Iubetur populus denuo numerari. Numerus sanctorum in libro vitae scribitur; gloria Christo in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Is-ordered people anew to-be-numbered. Number of-saints in book of-life is-written; glory to-Christ into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: The people are ordered numbered again. The saints’ number is written [[in the book of life >> Bible:Revelation 20:12]]. Glory to Christ forever. Amen.
